question: Which of the following rivers flow through a rift valley?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tapi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** two largest rivers** in India that flow through rift valleys are the **Narmada and the Tapi.**
 
• One of the rivers in India, the Narmada, flows between the Satpura and Vindhya hills in a rift valley and towards the west.
 
• The Damodar River in the Chota Nagpur Plateau and Tapti are among the other rivers that run through the** rift valley.**
 
• In a rift valley, the **Tapi River flows**.
 
• Three rivers in India pass through a valley known as the Rift.
 
• The Narmada and the Damodar rivers are the other two that pass through a rift valley.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A rift vall
